from rich.console import Console
from rich.table import Table

console = Console()
table = Table(title='Report')
table.add_column('{{col_a}}', style='cyan')
table.add_column('{{col_b}}', style='magenta', justify='right')

rows = [('alpha', '1'), ('beta', '2'), ('gamma', '3')]
for a, b in rows:
    table.add_row(a, b)

console.print(table)
